# Introduction

Company A operates a complex multi-agent AI system with many automated behaviours and unclear interactions. Recently, an unexpected gibberish post was made on SaidIt by John Windward at 17 May 2046, 4:21am appearing in an unrelated forum raises concerns about a possible agent malfunction. This project aims to build a visual analytics system that helps investigate how the post was created by mapping the sequence of people and system interactions, understanding the meaning and origin of the post content, comparing the incident against historical system behaviour, and identifying a suitable intervention point to reduce the chance of similar issues happening again.
